name: Corner Display Unit: Black Melamine
description: Corner display units are perfect end caps to a showcase. Corner display units help connect multiple showcases so you can form your own island or kiosk configurations. Display shelves provide ample space for merchandise. The glass shelves are adjustable to accomodate new merchandise. POP displays, such as this corner display unit and other glass display cases, are easy to re-arrange as your store layout changes. This corner display unit and additional glass display cases is made of black melamine laminate and is durable and easy to clean off. This display stand comes with leveler feet which also help reduce scratches on the floor when the case is moved. Every piece of glass in this display case is tempered , this process makes the glass several times stronger than regular glass. It also makes it safer because when broken it yields small, more managable pieces. Take a look at what other cases are made with . Standard plate glass (annealed) remains in large pieces when broken and is a danger to you and your customers. Note: This corner display unit, including other glass display cases, arrives disassembled. Click here for instructions! Dimensions: Overall: 18"w x 38"h x 18"d Bottom shelf is 10" off the ground
